meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-09-02 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c3d: level with last night (53) · -1 vs 7-night avg (54)
en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: Score 85 on 8h 06m — the longest night in this window and the earliest lights-out, 22:18 to 06:33. Three points above the night before, 64 minutes over the 7h 02m average, and the only night on this board to clear eight hours. Garmin graded it good. The mechanism is the awake column. Nine minutes awake across the whole night and 98% sleep efficiency, second-cleanest of the seven behind Sunday's zero. That column is now the clearest signal here: your three lowest awake totals — 0, 9 and 11 minutes — produced your three highest scores, 94, 85 and 82, while the 64-minute night produced the 65. Nothing else on this board separates the nights that cleanly. The stages mostly followed. REM 1h 57m at 24%, second-highest of the seven behind Sunday's 2h 05m. Light 5h 01m, the largest light block in the window, which is what an eight-hour night does. Deep is the one number that did not come along: 1h 08m at 14%, fourth of seven, well under Thursday's 1h 44m. Deep and REM together made 3h 05m, 38% of the night. Autonomics split, and the split is worth reading properly. RHR held 53 for a third night running, one under the 54 baseline and tied for the lowest of the seven. Overnight stress read 16, second-lowest in the window against 29 the night before. But HRV came in at 39, down ten from last night's 49 — the biggest single-night drop on this board, and it fell off what was the highest reading of the seven. That is not a warning. Yesterday was your deadlift day: 75 minutes, avg HR 122, max 157, peak stress 95, 728 active kcal. A ten-point HRV dip the morning after a heavy hinge is the expected autonomic bill, and it is arriving alongside a lower RHR, lower overnight stress and a longer, cleaner night. When the markers disagree in that direction, sleep and RHR are the more reliable pair. Readiness 80. Keep the bedtime. 22:18 is the earliest on the board by 32 minutes, it bought you 8h 06m, and it produced the second-best score of the seven off a day that cost ten points of HRV — that is the lever paying out again. Train today, but keep it aerobic or technical rather than heavy; give the HRV one more day before the next hard session.

hr.c3d: isto kao sinoć (53) · -1 vs prosjek 7 noći (54)
hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Ocjena 85 uz 8h 06m — najduža noć u ovom prozoru i najranije gašenje svjetla, od 22:18 do 06:33. Tri boda iznad prethodne noći, 64 minute iznad prosjeka od 7h 02m i jedina noć na ovoj ploči koja je prešla osam sati. Garmin ju je ocijenio dobrom. Mehanizam je stupac budnosti. Devet minuta budnosti kroz cijelu noć i 98% učinkovitost sna, drugo najčišće od sedam iza nedjeljne nule. Taj je stupac sada najjasniji signal ovdje: tvoja tri najniža zbroja budnosti — 0, 9 i 11 minuta — dala su tri najviše ocjene, 94, 85 i 82, dok je noć od 64 minute dala 65. Ništa drugo na ovoj ploči ne razdvaja noći tako čisto. Faze su uglavnom pratile. REM 1h 57m i 24%, drugi najviši od sedam iza nedjeljnih 2h 05m. Laki san 5h 01m, najveći blok lakog sna u prozoru, što je ono što donese osmosatna noć. Duboki san je jedini broj koji nije pošao za njima: 1h 08m i 14%, četvrti od sedam, znatno ispod četvrtkovih 1h 44m. Duboki i REM zajedno dali su 3h 05m, 38% noći. Autonomika je podijeljena i tu podjelu vrijedi pročitati kako treba. RHR se treću noć zaredom zadržao na 53, jedan ispod osnovice od 54 i izjednačen s najnižim od sedam. Noćni stres 16, drugi najniži u prozoru naspram 29 prethodne noći. Ali HRV je bio 39, deset niže od sinoćnjih 49 — najveći jednonoćni pad na ovoj ploči, i to s onoga što je bilo najviše očitanje od sedam. To nije upozorenje. Jučer je bio tvoj dan mrtvog dizanja: 75 minuta, prosječni puls 122, maksimalni 157, vršni stres 95, 728 aktivnih kcal. Pad HRV-a od deset bodova jutro nakon teškog pregiba očekivani je autonomni račun, a stiže uz niži RHR, niži noćni stres i dužu, čišću noć. Kad se pokazatelji razilaze u tom smjeru, san i RHR su pouzdaniji par. Spremnost 80. Zadrži vrijeme lijeganja. 22:18 je najranije na ploči za 32 minute, donijelo ti je 8h 06m i dalo drugu najbolju ocjenu od sedam nakon dana koji te koštao deset bodova HRV-a — to je poluga koja opet plaća. Treniraj danas, ali neka bude aerobno ili tehničko, a ne teško; daj HRV-u još jedan dan prije sljedećeg tvrdog treninga.
